{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater, slim fit, crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2F), merino wool
Midi skirt, A-line with soft pleats, mid-calf length, black (#1C1C1E), matte crepe
Opaque tights, 40 denier, black (#1C1C1E), nylon-elastane blend
Single-breasted coat, straight cut, knee length, camel (#B98B5E), wool blend
Ankle boots, almond toe, 5 cm block heel, black (#1A1A1A), smooth leather
Small structured shoulder bag, black (#1A1A1A), grained leather
Small hoop earrings, thin, warm gold (#C9A24B), polished metal

This outfit sits in the neat band: a refined knit with a skirt and ankle boots is polished enough for a restaurant date without feeling overdressed. The burgundy knit is rich and warm in artificial evening light, and the soft sheen of the pleated skirt adds movement when you sit and walk. Black below keeps the look grounded, and the camel coat brings warmth for a cool autumn evening and is easy to hand over at the cloakroom. The block heel is comfortable for the whole evening, and the gold hoops add a small, flattering touch of light near the face."}
